crossRefs.note: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.
